question:
In namespace `spectro`, the Deployment `prism` should run 3 replicas, but none of its Pods are being created. Find out why.

Fix it without changing the ResourceQuota `spectro-budget` and without adding `resources` to the Deployment:

1. Create a LimitRange `spectro-defaults` of type `Container` with default limits `cpu: 100m`, `memory: 128Mi` and default requests `cpu: 50m`, `memory: 64Mi`.
2. Make sure all 3 replicas of `prism` are Running and Ready with these defaults applied. After many failed attempts the ReplicaSet controller only retries after a long back-off, so restart the Deployment's rollout once the LimitRange exists.

verification.description: LimitRange spectro-defaults sets container defaults (limits 100m/128Mi, requests 50m/64Mi)
Deployment prism has 3/3 ready Pods carrying the LimitRange defaults
prism Pods are admitted while ResourceQuota spectro-budget is unchanged and the Deployment declares no resources
